need.label: U.S. cancer survivors
need.scope_note: Survivorship begins at diagnosis and includes people with widely different treatment and follow-up needs.

funding.scope_note: Lead-institute proxy; cancer research is also funded outside NCI and outside NIH.

digital_leverage.basis: Rich longitudinal, imaging, pathology, genomic, pharmacy, trial, and claims data; workflow complexity and high regulatory burden create both opportunity and friction.

strategy.labor: Extend oncology teams through navigation, symptom management, survivorship, prior-authorization support, trial matching, and multidisciplinary coordination.
strategy.applications: Avoid generic cancer apps. Focus on care transitions, treatment toxicity, financial navigation, structured pathology and genomics, and operational gaps with an identifiable clinical owner.
strategy.group: Use oncology as a partnership-rich domain, but enter through a narrow workflow where Baltimore institutions, patient groups, and implementers can validate impact.
